recommendations.recommendation: Go to bed and rise early.
recommendations.rationale: Early hours make one healthy, wealthy, and wise.

recommendations.recommendation: Be industrious and diligent.
recommendations.rationale: Diligence brings good luck, and God helps those who help themselves.

recommendations.recommendation: Be frugal and watch small expenses.
recommendations.rationale: A small leak will sink a great ship; a penny saved is a penny earned.

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid debt.
recommendations.rationale: Borrowing brings sorrow, and creditors have better memories than debtors.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not waste time.
recommendations.rationale: Lost time is never found again, and time is the stuff of which life is made.

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid sloth.
recommendations.rationale: Sloth consumes faster than labor wears, like rust.

recommendations.recommendation: Attend to your own business personally.
recommendations.rationale: If you want it done, go; if not, send someone.

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid pride in dress and appearances.
recommendations.rationale: Pride starts with plenty, then poverty, and ends in disgrace.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not put off until tomorrow what you can do today.
recommendations.rationale: Delays are dangerous, and one today is worth two tomorrows.

recommendations.recommendation: Eat to live rather than live to eat; be moderate in food and drink.
recommendations.rationale: Overindulgence harms health and wealth.

recommendations.recommendation: Keep your eyes wide open before marriage and half shut afterward.
recommendations.rationale: Careful choice beforehand and tolerance afterward make for a good marriage.

recommendations.recommendation: Be careful with secrets; they are rarely kept.
recommendations.rationale: 3 may keep a secret only if 2 of them are dead.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not overstay your welcome as a guest.
recommendations.rationale: Guests, like fish, begin to smell after 3 days.

recommendations.recommendation: Learn from others' experience rather than only from your own costly mistakes.
recommendations.rationale: Experience is a costly school, yet fools will learn in no other.

recommendations.recommendation: Value deeds over words.
recommendations.rationale: Well done is better than well said.

recommendations.recommendation: Be slow in choosing a friend and slower in changing one.
recommendations.rationale: Careful choice and loyalty make friendships lasting.

recommendations.recommendation: Control your anger.
recommendations.rationale: Anger always has a reason, but seldom a good one.

recommendations.recommendation: Work as if you will live 100 years, and pray as if you will die tomorrow.
recommendations.rationale: This balances diligence in worldly affairs with readiness for eternity.

recommendations.recommendation: Love your enemies, for they show you your faults.
recommendations.rationale: Enemies reveal flaws that friends may hide.

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid bad company.
recommendations.rationale: He who lies down with dogs rises with fleas.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not rush; haste leads to waste.
recommendations.rationale: Hurried work produces errors and loss.
